name: Serizawa Kaho
source:
Great grades and straight as an arrow. With a gentle personality and graceful way of carrying herself, she is popular with older and younger students and even among students of the same sex. She lives in a spectacular mansion on a hill with her father, a famed painter. Born with a silver spoon in her mouth and a bit of a princess, she is not much in the kitchen or one for housework.

Before summer vacation, Kaho was out of Koutarou's league and he was just one of Kaho's many admirers. However, through time travel, Koutarou leams that in the near future the two will fall in love and of her tragic death as well.

[from official materials]
